impactDetail.description: This pillar connects HydroRivers product value with the Brazilian cabotage strategy: broaden competition, improve fleet usage, reduce logistics costs and encourage more sustainable vessels.

cost: Consolidation of fragmented cargoes on river routes.
Higher vessel occupancy and fewer empty returns.
Proposal comparison and auditable price history.
sustainability: Cabotage and waterways emit less per transported ton.
Incentives for operators with more efficient vessels.
regional: Pilot routes between Belém, Santarém, Manaus and Porto Velho.
Focus on cooperatives, small producers and local operators.
automation: Quote, counteroffer and acceptance in one digital workflow.
Documents and proofs attached to the negotiation.
brdomar: Alignment with Law No. 14,301/2022 and cabotage incentives.
Integration with Brazilian ports and other modes.
Reduced road dependence and cargo theft risk.
compliance: Fiscal, environmental and sanitary documents stop being a generic checklist.
Required, conditional and next-phase states reduce contracting risk.
The mocked trail prepares the app for real integrations with agencies and systems.
connectivity: The app recognizes that not every river section has stable signal.
Events can be recorded as operational evidence and synced later.
This creates a realistic narrative for communities and smaller terminals.
government: Corridor dashboards show supply, bioeconomy, risk and documentation.
Territorial intelligence helps prioritize public policy and inspection.
HydroRivers supports coordination, not only quoting.
